headline: The draft-only INT4 lm_head, measured on this lane at 28% of the decode step, scores only a shortlist of vocabulary rows; the target verifies every draft with its full head, so no output can change. With the 67,248-row union list (27% of the vocabulary) the one-card depth-3 headline goes from 113.48 / 113.49 (same image, no shortlist) to 124.03 / 124.13 tok/s, +9.3%, every gate 12/12, acceptance unchanged (0.928 / 0.827 / 0.726 per position against 0.919 / 0.787 / 0.712).
method: As the 4B campaign (experiments/qwen35-4b-b70/data/2026-09-12-qwen35-4b-draft-head-shortlist.json): image R294b, one card, depth 3, CLASSPAD=0, strict stage (fresh MTP0 pair, shortlisted depth-3 pair, G1/G2/G3). Chain scripts/run-20260912-qwen35-9b-draft-shortlist-chain.sh.

slu67k.note: lab text united with the broad corpus top 65,536; 99.5% of this model's suite output

slbase.note: same image, no shortlist; equals the published 113.63 / 112.90

reading: Same shape as the 4B: +9.3% at 32k and 67k rows, +7.7% at 92k. At 32k acceptance at the later positions drops (0.738 / 0.669) and the smaller head pays for it; at 67k acceptance is the control's and the gain is all head savings. 67k is the list to serve on both models.
